# CircularProgressChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasCircularProgressChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasCircularProgressChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasCircularProgressChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasCircularProgressChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Angle / radius space: polar series, radial bars, activity rings, ringed infographic

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCircularProgressChart> CreateCircularProgressChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCircularProgressChart> CreateConcentricRingChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, double>>& labeledPercentages);   // Convenience: concentric rings from (label, percent) pairs.
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCircularProgressChart> CreateProgressPieChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h, const std::string& label, double percent, const Color& color = Colors::Transparent);   // Convenience: one-value progress pie (filled sector over a track disc).
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasCircularProgressChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### struct `ProgressRing`

One ring of the chart. `value` is mapped onto the ring's arc sweep via the [minValue, maxValue] range (0..100 by default, so values read as percentages out of the box).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `std::string label` |  |
| `value` | `double value = 0.0` |  |
| `minValue` | `double minValue = 0.0` |  |
| `maxValue` | `double maxValue = 100.0` |  |
| `color` | `Color color = Colors::Transparent` | Transparent = take from palette |
| `iconPath` | `std::string iconPath` | optional icon for the legend chip |

### enum `CircularProgressStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ConcentricRings` | One arc per ring on its own radius (default) |
| `SingleRing` | Only the first ring, drawn at full thickness |
| `ProgressPie` | First ring as a filled sector over a track disc |

### enum `RingCapStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Butt` |  |
| `Round` |  |

### enum `RingTrackMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AutoTint` | Pale tint of the ring's own colour (default) |
| `Explicit` | The colour given to SetTrackColor for every ring |
| `Hidden` | No background track |

### enum `RingTipLabel`

Content of the callout at the end of each arc.
